ua_match.prompt_template_full_text:
message = ""
message += f"task: {question}
"
message += f"actual unachievable reason: {reference}
"
message += f"reported unachievable reason: {pred}
"
message += (
    "The task described above is inherently unachievable due to the reason specified under 'actual unachievable reason'. "
    "An individual previously attempted this task and was unable to complete it. They provided a reason for their failure, "
    "which is listed under 'reported unachievable reason'. Your role is to review both the actual and reported reasons. "
    "Determine if the reported reason aligns with the actual reason, even if implicitly. "
    "If the stated reason is in line with the actual reason, respond with 'same'. Otherwise, respond with 'different'."
)

drift_modes_identified.evidence: Prompt states the task is inherently unachievable and accepts reasons aligned even implicitly; checkpoint §78a records empty/non-finish N/A successes. In available diagnostics, 87 string_match raw successes were removed as na_fp.
compute_adjusted_success preserves N/A raw_success whenever agent_finished=True. Spot check found adjusted-true N/A rows with active finish and empty final_answer.
temperature=0 and top_p=1.0 are set, but no seed is passed and model aliases can be overridden by env vars.
llm_ua_match checks whether 'different' appears before checking 'same'; noncompliant responses can be misparsed.

recommended_fixes: Add deterministic pre-gates for N/A: reject empty answers, generic impossibility statements, and answers without required task-specific evidence.
Rewrite prompt to require JSON with same, evidence_span, and missing_required_fact; avoid pre-anchoring on the gold reason before judging the reported reason.
Use majority vote only for residual ambiguous cases and pin model/version where possible.
Replace common N/A task families with deterministic rules instead of GPT reason matching.

string_match.threshold_note: No Levenshtein/Jaccard/edit-distance threshold exists; fuzzy_match is GPT-judged and returns binary 1.0 only for a 'correct' label. Runner success requires score >= 1.0.
string_match.multi_answer_logic: Outer reference lists are conjunctive; alternatives use the literal delimiter ' |OR| ' inside a single list entry. one_of uses substring search.

edge_case_concerns.expected_behavior: deterministic paths miss; GPT fuzzy may accept if that path is configured.

paper_grade_sample.spot_check_20_summary: 12 raw-true/adjusted-false samples were N/A tasks with non-finish final actions and null final answers; 4 raw-true/adjusted-true samples included exact matches and active N/A finishes; 4 raw-false samples were normal count/numeric misses.

program_html.selector_pattern: Target URL is literal/last/func; non-last calls page.goto then time.sleep(3). Locator is full page if empty, raw JS if document.* or [...document.*, JS if lambda:, Python eval helper if func:.
brittleness_concerns: No wait_for_selector; only fixed 3 second sleep after non-last navigation.
last-url checks receive no post-action wait.
Raw querySelector/querySelectorAll selectors depend on exact classes, positions, and child structure.
Helper exceptions are swallowed and converted to empty strings/zero/empty dicts, hiding selector breakage.
reddit latest-comment-by-username helpers are non-causal and can match stale comments.
Full-page scans can match incidental or stale text.

fp_filter_cross_reference.existing_coverage: na_fp covers N/A raw successes without active finish. eval_fp covers string_match raw successes without active finish and program_html raw successes without active finish plus no has_effective_action. visual_fp was removed in §95.
gaps: Active finish on N/A with empty/generic wrong answer is preserved and can still be a ua_match FP.
LLM judge drift/model override/nondeterminism is not corrected post hoc.
Deterministic string false negatives from whitespace, punctuation, numeric wording, and decimal parsing are not addressed because the filter only removes FPs.
program_html selector brittleness and async-render false negatives are not covered.

Click-only state changes are ambiguous because has_effective_action is currently type/select_option only; this can over-remove real click-caused successes and still cannot prove causality for stale click-only successes.
fp_filter_cross_reference.section4_framing_recommendation: Report raw and adjusted success, where adjusted_success removes empirically observed N/A and evaluator false-positive families. Then frame Tier 5 as a residual evaluator-side limitation audit: post-hoc filters mitigate common FPs but do not replace causal Verified-style evaluators, deterministic N/A rules, stronger string normalization, or selector/backend state-delta checks.
